description: This file defines an interface and an abstract class related to object pooling in the Orleans streaming framework. It includes the IObjectPool<T> interface for managing pooled objects and the PooledResource<T> class for resources that track their originating pool.

classes.name: PooledResource<T>
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for pooled objects that can return themselves to the pool upon disposal.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a pooled resource from the pool.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns a resource to the pool.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Handles purging of the resource, default implementation calls Dispose.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Returns the object to the pool if a pool is assigned, resetting its internal state.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets the object to a clean state, callable upon pooling or purging.
